message.content: {"caption":"Three-panel diagram comparing how a vanilla memory system and an RL-finetuned memory system handle information about two dog adoptions across sessions.","description":"The left panel shows a multi-session dialogue: Andrew first says he adopted a dog named Buddy, then later says he adopted another dog named Scout. The middle panel shows a vanilla LLM memory manager treating the new information as a contradiction, issuing DELETE and ADD operations, and answering “1 dog”; red crosses mark the incorrect outcomes. The right panel shows an RL-finetuned system updating the memory to say Andrew adopted two dogs named Buddy and Scout, then distilling retrieved memories to answer “2 dogs”; green check marks indicate the correct outcomes.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
